sanskrit: arcanatvāgnikāryaṃ ca nityotsava navotsavaṃtailaṃ tu prathamaṃ vidyāt dvitīyaṃ gulamucyatepañcamaṃsīsakaṃ siddhi ṣaṣṭamaṃ sīnamucyatetribaṃdhaṃ kena saṃyuktau | * * * * * * * *vāmahastakapaddīpa kaṇḍodaramahodaraṃaṣṭabhūdāsamākhyāta dvinetrādvibhujānvitāpītāṃbarasamāyuktā śūlahastābhayaṃkarādvibhujaṃ ca triṇetraṃ ca śyāmavarṇasuyauvanamśaktāṃbarasamāyuktā saraktamakuṭānvitampīnokṛpīna jaghanaṃ sarvāvayava śobhitamprasugrīvasupāśaiśca atisuṃdararūpavānyakṣe śodhanadejaṃ bhole mālirūpakamnarendraśceti vikhyātaṃ yakṣāścekadaśāsmṛtāḥnānāvarṇasamāyuktā raktamālā samāyutādukūlavāsasaṃyuktaṃ śobhanāvayavairyutamyakṣāṇāmapi sarveṣāmākṛtiḥ kathyate mayācitrasena mahāsena samitra sumukhaṃ tathāgaṃdharvāstviti vikhyātā dvibhujāśca dvinetrakaṃśyāmaraktaṃ ca kalmāṣaṃ kramādgandharvavarṇakāḥsarvābharaṇasaṃyuktā raktavastrottarīyakāḥtālaṃ vīṇāṃ ca vaṃśaṃ ca vādyakarma tathaiva cakṛtāñjali puṭovāpi iti vādana tatparābhayagrīvokta yatsarvaṃ kālanetra mahābalayātudhānāstuti khyātā raktaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ca varṇakaṃpiṃgasindhūrakañcaiva dhūmravarṇaṃ tathaiva ca

sanskrit: sthūlaṃ caiva krameṇaiva śivādi parilakṣyatetatvamūrtiprabhāvaṃ ca tribhedaṃ vidyate kramāttayoryogena yadrūpaṃ tadrūpamaṃgamucyatesantataṃ śivabhāvatvātsādākhyamiti kīrtitaṃniṣkalaṃ tatvamityuktaṃ sakalaṃ mūrtirucyateniṣkalaṃ dehirityuktaṃ sakalaṃ dehamucyatesarveṣāṃ dhyānapūjārthaṃ sakalaṃ niṣkalaṃ bhavetpañcasādākhya tatvānāṃ udbhavaṃ hi pṛthak pṛthakśāntyatīta parāśakti tasya pariyāya vācakāparāgamyodbhavā ca śudhyatvācchivamucyatebindurūpamivākāśaṃ pratyakṣaṃ sarvatomukhaṃādiśaktiśca śāṃtiśca tasya paryāya vācakāḥādiśaktiśca mūrtitvāt damūlaṃ ceti kīrtitaṃsūryakoṭi pratīkāśaṃ jyotisaṃpākṛtiḥ smṛtiḥete vai divyaliṃgaṃ tu mūlastaṃbhamihocyateicchāśaktiśca vidyā ca tasya paryāyavācakāḥicchāmūrtiguṇatvācca tasya mūrtimudāhṛdaṃjvālāgni sadṛśaprakhyaṃ * * * * * * * *mūrtitatvātkalāyuktaṃ rūpaṃ ceti prakīrtitaṃtasyordhvāṃśaika bhāve tu ekavaktreṇa saṃyutamsācāmikānanopetaṃ liṃgamūrtirudāhataṃjñānaṃ hi śuddharūpatvāt sphaṭikābhaṃ taducyatetasya madhye sthito mūrtiṃ īśvaraḥ sarvakāraṇaṃcaturāsya caturnāsi vasuśrotrasamanvitaṃśūlaṃ paraśukhaḍgaṃ ca abhayaṃ dakṣiṇe kare

sanskrit: sarvālaṃkāra saṃyuktaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaṃkartṛsādākhyamevoktaṃ karmasādākhyamucyatekriyāśaktirdaśāṃsena karma sādākhyadbhavamliṃgapīṭhe prakāreṇa karmasādākhyamudbhavaṃnādaṃ binduyutaṃ rūpaṃ karmasādākhyamucyateliṃgaśaṃburiti jñeyaṃ pīṭhaśaktirudāhṛtaṃtadā saṃyoga bhāvatvāt karmabhāvamudāhṛtammūrtimadhye gataṃ tatvaṃ tatvamadhye gataṃ śivamliṃgena jāyate tatra jagatsthāvarajaṃgamamkarmodayena sṛṣṭissyātkarmānte saṃhṛtirbhavetpañcasādākhya yonena karmasādākhyamucyateamūrtaṃ hi mahāsena śivasādākhyamāśritaḥtasmātkarmeśarūpaṃ tu pañcamūrtyāśrayaṃ viduḥetadvai mūrtipiṇḍitvā piṇḍikāryamiti smṛtaṃpiṇḍena piṇḍitaṃ piṇḍaṃ piṇḍarūpamudāhṛtampañcamūrtimayaṃ devaṃ pañcatatvātmakaṃ bhavettadbheda kṛttu maheśādi sarvatatvādisaṃbhavādevasyotta kalopeto taṃ dhātupiṇḍamiti smṛtaṃsarvāṃgāni ca saṃpūrṇaṃ sarvāvayavasundaramniṣkalaṃ tadapāye tu tasmātsakalāniṣkalaṃcaṃdracāpamivākāśe darpaṇaṃ prati biṃbavatdhyānalakṣaṇamevoktaṃ aṃgabhāvamathocyateaśmānonamavohasya kūlamekaṃ dvidhākṛtiḥniṣkalaśśailajā kartṛ sakalaṃ bhāvyarūpakaṃkalātatvāni varṇāni maṃtrāṇi bhuvanāni hi

sanskrit: nivṛttiṃ ca pratiṣṭhā ca vidyā śāṃtistathaiva camantrādhvā ca padādhvā ca varṇārdhvā rūpanāmakaṃtasya krameṇa nivṛttiśca pratiṣṭājalameva caākāśe śāntyātītāśca bhūtavyāpte supañca catatvādvā saṃkhya ṣaḍtriṃśatkalādhvā ṣoḍaśā kalāvarṇādhvā ekapañcāśa ṣaḍadhvāsaṃkhyameva vāācāryalakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣvekāgramānasaḥśivasiddhāṃta śāstrajñaḥ sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥnṛṇāṃ patni saṃyukti śivabhakti samanvitamsarvalakṣaṇasaṃpanna śaivācāryassa ucyatepatnihīnena prāpteṇa arcirādi yathā talamtadgrāmavāsināṃ martyā kṣutpipāsādi pīḍitāḥtatkarmantu punaḥ kṛtvā prāyaścittapurassaraṃkusumadṛk mithyāvarākī bakabekāpyeṣu śivā-tantreṇa dīkṣāṃ kṛtvā tu vaḥ śivaḥ -kāmikādyeka bhāgaṃ tu na doṣāya tu saṃkaraḥanuktaṃ cettathānyena saṃgrahaṃ sarvamācarettena doṣeṇa yadvastu rāṣṭranāśaṃ bhaviṣyatiyadimo na kuvandistha nānābaṃdhanakṣayamyasmin taṃtre prakartavyaṃ anya taṃtreṇa kārayetkarmaṇādi pratiṣṭāṃ taṃ ekataṃtreṇa kārayetpūrvamekena kṛtvā tu paścādanyena vai kṛtaḥtacchiṣyeṇā vaśiṣṭaṃ tat kartavyaṃ hi ṣaḍānanasaṃkareti sati rāṣṭraṃ nāśanaṃ ca na saṃśayaḥadhamaṃ śāstraṃ vijñeyaṃ trividhaṃ śilpalakṣaṇaṃ

sanskrit: śaivaṃ pāśupadaṃ somaṃ lākulaṃ tu caturvidhamyasmin taṃtre samāraṃbhaṃ karṣaṇādyarcanāntakaṃsaumyamārhataṃ caiva śaivaṃ pāśupataṃ tathāyika vaiśeṣaśaivāssarve prakurvītīti gṛhasthā-rātrike | bauddhe cārhate caiva * * * * pi caśaivā kurvanti dīkṣāśca talliṃga sthāpanādikaṃadhikārosti sarvasya nānyeṣāṃ śivadarśaneśivavipreṇa kartavyaṃ anyeṣāṃ svārthameva hitadrāṣṭrasya vināśastu acireṇa na saṃśayaḥrīśanirīkṣaṇāt | yatkṛtamaṇḍapa gopura-atha tatvāni ṣaḍtriṃśan pṛthivyap-pasthau ca pāyu ca | pādau pāṇi ca vāṅnāsā jihvā-vajñayastvayā | rāgoniyati vidyāṃ ca kalākālaṃ-iti smṛtaṃ | tatva tatveśvaraṃ nyāsaṃ mūrtimūrtīśvarā-khyaṃ tu tatvatrayamiti smṛtaṃ | kṣmāvahniyajamānārka-rudrākhyo bhava eva ca | īśānaṃ ca mahādevo-pañcamūrtyātmako nyāso kaṣṭā vāri dahanānilāḥindrāśyāgni yamaścaiva nir-ṛtirvaruṇastathāanaṃteśastathā sūkṣma śivoktaṃ cekanetrakamaṣṭavidyeśvarāścete triṇetrāśca caturbhujāḥśrīvatsaṃ svastikaṃ śaṃkhaṃ dīpo devāṣṭamaṃgalaṃjvālāghaṃ jālajaṃghaṃ ca lohajaṃ tṛvidhā bhavetdharo dhṛ somanīlaṃ ca pramukhaṃ ca prabhāvakampaiśācaṃ rākṣasaṃ yakṣaṃ gandharvaṃ aindrameva cavāmā jyeṣṭhā raudrī ca kālī kalavikaraṇīṃ tathā

sanskrit: śaktiḥ tataḥ śaktyātmakatvāt sūkṣmarūpatvātmahatvaṃ darśayati prāṇāḥ indriyāṇi yaṃprāṇāṃtaṃ-apānaṃ taṃ ceṣṭāṃ vyajantaḥ apānanti ceṣṭāṃ tyajaṃti-yatā nimnokte nakṣatre sādikaṃ ca virāṭ jīvā-bhakṣituṃ icchatha ityarthaḥ | prāk prathamaṃ nira-indriyaṃ nānāraso viṣaya varuṇo devatā jñāta-ityetaccatuṣṭayaṃ anuktamapyūham | vivakṣomukhato-suṣiraṃ nirodhassamajāyata | nāsike nirabhi-vahno ghrāṇo na nasijighrakṣati | yadātmani ni-jyotiścakṣurguṇagraham | bodhyamānasya ṛṣibhiḥdiśaśrotraṃ guṇagrahaṃ | vivakṣoḥ vaktumicchātaḥbhāṣaṇaṃ tayoriti indriya devatādhīnatvakaṃmāne'tyaṃtaṃ pralapati tatra nasi nāsikāyāṃ-na gaṃdho viṣayī darśitaḥ ghrāṇa indriyaṃ jighṛ-śūnyamāsīditi śeṣaḥ nirmakṣikamitivat-vasatu didṛkṣatā akṣiṇī sthānaṃ jyotirādityo-grahaṇaṃ anena rūpaṃ viṣayo darśitaḥ | ṛṣibhiḥ-gṛhītumicchataḥ tato guṇagṛhaṃ śabdagrahaṇamjighṛkṣata stvaṅnirbhirṇā tasyāṃ romamahīruhāhastau ruhatustasya nānākarmacikīrṣayāgatiṃcikīrṣaḥ pādau ruruhāte hi kāmikāṃvastunādharmān mṛduñca kāṭhinyaṃ ca gurutvaṃ ca-yadyapi anuṣṇatvamapi indriya viṣaya eva-vṛṣṇeti pāṭheyaṇādiśaśyāṃdasaḥ | pūrvoktān vastūntvagindriyādhiṣṭānaṃ carmajātaṃ ityarthaḥ
